map.：原价 80，现价 100：变化率=(100-80)/80×100%=25%（涨: Original price 80, current price 100: change = (100-80)/80 x 100% = 25% (a 25% rise). Going the other way, 100 to 80 gives (80-100)/100 = -20% (a 20% fall). Note that a different base gives a different result.

map.百分比变化的基数怎么选？: How do you choose the base for a percentage change?
map.统一用「（新-旧）/旧×100%」。涨跌幅不对称：从 80 到 100 是 +2: Always use "(new - old) / old x 100%". Upside and downside are asymmetric: from 80 to 100 is +25%, while from 100 back to 80 is -20%, because the base changed.
map.多个百分比能直接相加吗？: Can several percentages simply be added?
map.不能直接加。复合变化用连乘 (1+r1)(1+r2)…-1，因为每次都基于新的基: They cannot simply be added. A combined change uses the product (1+r1)(1+r2)...-1, because each step is based on a new base.
